title: Regime-timeline blocking gates — same-quadrant-run semantics amendment (fresh-density scope)
summary: AMENDS open_macro_v03_phase0q_005: the max_same_quadrant_run_months gate is judged ONLY over same-quadrant runs whose fresh-valid density is BELOW same_quadrant_run_min_fresh_density (0.50) — i.e. carry/latch anchors, the gate's original target. A run sustained by fresh month-by-month revalidation is genuine macro persistence (evidence: the 2021-01..2022-05 expansion, 17 months at carry <= 1, which every confidence-v2 candidate cell reproduces) and is surfaced as a diagnostic (raw_max_same_quadrant_run_months), never a failure. All five gate BOUNDS are unchanged from phase0q_005. Staleness remains independently bounded by max_carry_age_months <= 3.

gate_semantics.min_fresh_valid_rate_36m: At least this fraction of the trailing 36 calendar months must carry a FRESH-VALID decision (a real, non-carried consumable decision). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.fresh_valid_rate.rolling_36m. Unchanged from phase0q_005.
gate_semantics.max_abstention_streak_months: The longest run of consecutive calendar months without a fresh valid decision must not exceed this. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_abstention_streak_months. Unchanged from phase0q_005.
gate_semantics.max_carry_age_months: The greatest calendar-month distance a carried position reaches from its last valid seed must not exceed this — the SAME bound the carry_decay_v1 runtime cap enforces (MAX_CARRY_MONTHS = 3). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_carry_age_months. Unchanged from phase0q_005.
gate_semantics.max_same_quadrant_run_months: AMENDED (this artifact): the longest run of calendar months in the SAME consumable quadrant, judged ONLY over runs whose fresh-valid density (fresh valid months / run length) is strictly below same_quadrant_run_min_fresh_density. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_low_density_same_quadrant_run_months; the unscoped run length stays reported as raw_max_same_quadrant_run_months (diagnostic). Rationale: with carry age independently capped at 3, an unscoped bound of 12 punishes fresh persistent regimes — no honest model should flip artificially to break a regime that genuinely lasted longer.
gate_semantics.min_upside_capture_bull_year: In every BULL calendar year (SPY total return > bull_year_spy_return_threshold over a FULL calendar year of common sessions), the strategy must capture at least this fraction of SPY's return; partial-coverage years are excluded, down/flat years out of scope. Judged on upside_capture_by_calendar_year. Unchanged from phase0q_005.

rationale: The phase0q_005 rationale scoped the same-quadrant gate to 'the 2023-02 -> 2026 contraction anchor the audit flagged' — a CARRY artifact: one stale seed latched and carried for years. The confidence-v2 recalibration evidence (PR #43, docs/calibration/open_macro_v03_confidence_v2_experiment_001.md) showed every candidate cell passing fresh-valid density, abstention and carry gates by wide margins while 'failing' the unscoped run bound solely on the fresh 2021-01..2022-05 expansion — 17 consecutive months in which all but one month carried a FRESH valid decision. That is regime persistence measured month-by-month, not staleness. This amendment restores the gate to its ratified intent (bounding carry anchors) by scoping it to low fresh-density runs, keeping the bound value 12 and every other bound exactly as ratified in phase0q_005. Consistent with the freeze rule, the amendment was motivated and evidenced ONLY by abstention/coverage/stability behaviour, never CAGR/Sharpe.

All five bounds unchanged; only the same-quadrant-run judging scope is amended as specified in gate_semantics.
